items.description: Explains when an unpaid booking balance affects new-booking eligibility.
examples: Can I book if I still have an unpaid balance?
May balance pa ako, pwede pa mag book?
What happens if I don't pay the remaining balance?
Can unpaid late fees block another booking?
does partial payment stop another booking
hard_negatives: can I pay the balance in person
what payment methods are accepted
can I pay 30 percent first

clarification.en: Are you asking about available payment methods, the 30% down payment, or paying the remaining balance?
clarification.fil: Ang tanong mo ba ay tungkol sa payment methods, 30% down payment, o pagbabayad ng remaining balance?
clarification.taglish: Are you asking about payment methods, the 30% down payment, or your remaining balance?

items.live_source: Authenticated GET /api/bookings/eligibility and GET /api/bookings/me

en: An ordinary partial payment does not block another booking before the balance is due. A remaining balance can block booking after the vehicle is returned or the return time passes, and a finalized unpaid late-return penalty can also block booking. Check your live eligibility for your account's result.
fil: Hindi awtomatikong humaharang sa bagong booking ang ordinary partial payment bago maging due ang balance. Maaaring ma-block ang booking kapag naibalik na ang vehicle o lumampas na ang return time at may balance pa, pati kapag may finalized unpaid late-return penalty. I-check ang live eligibility ng account mo.
taglish: An ordinary partial payment does not block another booking before the balance is due. A due balance after return or a finalized unpaid late-return penalty can block booking, so check your live eligibility.

notes: Python is the single semantic intent-classification authority; Node validates the result and fulfills live-data responses.
Policy responses use the first approved response per language; response variation is reserved for conversational intents.
Exact availability, rates, booking status, balances, refunds, penalties, extensions, and account-specific information require authoritative backend data.
Insurance and security-deposit answers are intentionally conditional until a selected listing or booking provides the applicable terms.
